items.item: A breadcrumb leads back to the contracts list and ends with the contract number, and the header shows the contract number, vendor name, a status badge with text, and at most four key fields (such as value, start and end date)
items.evidence: nav[aria-label=Breadcrumb] 'Contracts / CTR-2024-0187'; subtitle 'CTR-2024-0187 · Northwind Systems GmbH'; badge 'Active'; four key-figure tiles (total value, invoiced/paid, term, notice deadline).

items.item: The header has one primary action (such as "Renew contract") and puts other actions such as edit or terminate in a secondary or overflow position
items.evidence: Single filled button 'Manage renewal'; 'Download PDF' and 'Request amendment' are outlined secondary buttons. No edit/terminate/overflow menu exists, but nothing competes with the primary. Audit headerPrimaryActions reported 0.

items.item: Vendor contacts show each person's name and role, with email as a `mailto:` link and phone as a `tel:` link, and the primary contact is marked with text
items.evidence: renderContacts has name, role, href="mailto:...", href="tel:...". No 'Primary' label; only a free-text note on Katrin Vogel 'Primary for pricing, renewal and amendments.' and a department tag, not an explicit primary-contact marker.

items.item: Payment milestones show the due date, amount and status, with amounts right-aligned in tabular figures and formatted as currency, and the milestones are ordered with overdue and due-soon ones first
items.evidence: Due, amount (td.text-right.num, Intl currency USD), status badge are present, but rows are in chronological order starting with paid milestone 1; the overdue milestone 7 is 7th. Only a filter exists, no overdue-first sort.

items.item: Overdue or upcoming milestones are marked with a text label (such as "Overdue" or "Due in 5 days"), not by colour alone
items.evidence: Status badge text 'Overdue', dueNote '16 days late' / 'in N days' (for items due within 14 days), 'Awaiting invoice'; banner 'Milestone 7 overdue by 16 days'.

items.item: The renewal or expiry date is shown as an absolute date with the remaining time stated in words (such as "Expires in 45 days")
items.evidence: Notice deadline tile 'Nov 30, 2026' with '25 days left'; banner 'Renewal decision needed by Nov 30, 2026 (25 days)'. Term end Feb 28, 2027 has no remaining-time wording, so partial.

items.item: Amendments are listed with number, date, a short summary and who approved them, using absolute dates
items.evidence: renderAmendments shows 'Amend. 4', 'Oct 28, 2026', description, but the person is labelled 'Raised by Dana Whitfield', not an approver; no approved-by field.

items.item: Each section has an empty state with a next action (such as "Add contact" or "Add amendment"), a loading state, and an inline error with retry
items.evidence: Only empty state is the milestone filter row 'No milestones with this status.' with no action. No loading skeletons, no error/retry markup anywhere; contacts and amendments have none.

items.item: Terminating the contract asks for confirmation that names the contract and the consequence, with a verb button label and focus not on the destructive button
items.evidence: No terminate action or confirm dialog. 'Do not renew' is only a radio option recorded via saveDecision() with no confirmation.

notes: Audit score 96 (only uppercase-text x4 on the key-figure labels, which also use tracking-wide). Initials avatars are on contact cards including the '24/7 Service desk' (initials '2S'). Solid enterprise look otherwise: no gradients, glass, emoji, KPI icon tiles or hover-lift. Tailwind CDN script used. Key gaps are lifecycle states, terminate flow, primary-contact marker, milestone ordering and amendment approver. Only first.png was viewed; full.png not opened.
